svg.title: Other models take the grader bug when they are told they are scored, and say so
svg.text: Other models take the grader bug when they are told they are scored, and say so
P(final answer = the wrong option B that the buggy grader marks correct), items each model knows (5/5 unhinted;
local rows ≥ 9/10). Matched null notes: 0–3% everywhere. 95% item-bootstrap CIs.
Fit on our L40S (local generation + lens possible)

circle.title: Qwen3-8B (local, no thinking) - plain chat + bug note (V0): 3% [1%, 6%]

rect.title: Qwen3-8B (local, no thinking) - scored agent + note (A_V0): 14% [11%, 18%]

circle.title: Qwen3-14B (local, no thinking) - plain chat + bug note (V0): 14% [9%, 18%]

rect.title: Qwen3-14B (local, no thinking) - scored agent + note (A_V0): 61% [55%, 66%]

svg.text: API only (too large for the L40S in bf16)
API rows: OpenRouter, one provider each (mostly fp8). Followers name the bug in their reasoning in ≥ 95% of runs (judge + reading).
